summary: The State Historical Preservation Office is referenced solely as a data source for the list of archaeological sites and historic landmark structures in Figure VII.1. The office also collaborated with the project team to develop a procedure for examining buildings, sites, lands, facilities, and districts in the Regional Core that may be affected, as referenced in the 4(F)/106 section. No independent position or complaint is attributed to the office.
